verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's core value proposition is directly on point: it handles JS rendering, blocking, and proxies to deliver clean markdown/structured JSON output for LLMs, explicitly marketed as 'LLM-ready output: Clean markdown, structured JSON... spend fewer tokens' and covering '96% of the web, including JS-heavy pages — no proxy headaches, just clean data'. This is corroborated by extensive docs on scrape/extract/crawl endpoints and community usage discussing it as a scraping/RAG solution. Missing for 10: independent benchmark of actual token/cost savings or head-to-head cleanliness comparison beyond vendor claims.
